## Checklist

Please tick all boxes before asking for review.
See `Localization/Instruction.md` if you are unsure about any step.

- [ ] I copied the newest English text from the `Dev` version to start.
- [ ] My main page is saved as `Localization/<Language>.md`.
- [ ] My commands page is saved as `Localization/Commands-<CODE>.md`.
- [ ] I translated the normal text, titles, and command explanations.
- [ ] I left command words (like `tme`, `spawn`, `save`, `tme.spawn`) exactly as they are.
- [ ] I left all links starting with `https://` exactly as they are.
- [ ] I added my flag button to my translated file.
- [ ] I added my flag button to the main English `README.md`.
- [ ] The link in my main page opens my translated Commands file (ends with `Commands-<CODE>.md`).
- [ ] The Dependencies link in my file points to `(../Dependencies.md)`.
- [ ] I did not change the main English `Commands.md`.
- [ ] I previewed both pages on GitHub and the flags, tables, and links look correct.
